response.sql: WITH overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) as overall_avg FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL), station_avgs AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) as station_avg FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation) SELECT AVG(sa.station_avg) as mean_bandwidth_usage, AVG(sa.station_avg) - oa.overall_avg as above_average FROM station_avgs sa, overall_avg oa WHERE sa.station_avg > oa.overall_avg

assumptions.assumption: The workflow first computes a per-station average for each observatory (mean of its telescopes' bandwidth usage), then filters to stations above the global average, then reports the mean of those filtered station averages.
